decisions.label: SUPPORTED

numbers.quote: Structure-controlled news summarization on the test data of Dataset D (the paper's new news-summary dataset).

decisions.rationale: T1 evaluates only Dataset D and explicitly notes a single run per system; “single-dataset” denotes the count of distinct evaluated datasets rather than a quoted numeral.

decisions.label: OVERSTATED
decisions.rationale: Content evidence is mixed: beam has lower ROUGE-L than two baselines but higher FactCC and AlignScore than those systems. Thus a general content-accuracy trade-off exceeds T1.

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: Fine-tuned LLaMa’s ROUGE-L is 22.01% versus vanilla LLaMa’s 47.18%, a 25.17-point drop and less than half the vanilla score, supporting “much lower.”

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: The edit variant’s human Match Score is 0.24 versus 0.55 for beam, a 0.31 absolute and roughly 56% relative reduction, supporting “much lower.”

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: The edit variant’s ROUGE-L is 15.28% versus 42.98% for beam, a 27.70-point and roughly 64% relative reduction, supporting “substantially lower.”

decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: T1 reports 0.59 and 0.64, but provides no equivalence criterion, uncertainty, repeated runs, or statistical test establishing that the FactCC scores are similar.
